question.text: The Investment Advisory Arrangement between an offshore fund and the Indian Manager in Parallel Structure is typically:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.1.3, Indian Manager provides non-binding investment advisory to offshore funds in Parallel Structure. The Trap: Binding would constitute management, affecting tax status. Cross-Exam Context: Tax neutrality preservation. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document non-binding nature to protect tax positioning of offshore fund.
